items.source: The central element is the Resource annotation for annotation-driven injection of named beans, by default from the containing Spring BeanFactory, with only mappedName references resolved in JNDI. The "alwaysUseJndiLookup" flag enforces JNDI lookups equivalent to standard Jakarta EE resource injection for name references and default names as well. The target beans can be simple POJOs, with no special requirements other than the type having to match.
items.translation: 中心元素是用于通过注解驱动注入命名 Bean 的 `Resource` 注解，默认情况下从包含的 Spring BeanFactory 中获取，仅解析 `mappedName` 引用中的 JNDI。`"alwaysUseJndiLookup" flag` 强制对 `name` 引用和默认名称执行与标准 Jakarta EE 资源注入等效的 JNDI 查找。目标 Bean 可以是简单的 POJO，除了类型必须匹配外没有其他特殊要求。

items.source: This post-processor includes support for the PostConstruct and PreDestroy annotations - as init annotation and destroy annotation, respectively - through inheriting from InitDestroyAnnotationBeanPostProcessor with pre-configured annotation types.
items.translation: 此后置处理器通过继承已预配置注解类型的InitDestroyAnnotationBeanPostProcessor，支持PostConstruct和PreDestroy注解——分别作为初始化注解和销毁注解。

items.source: If a non-null object is returned by this method, the bean creation process will be short-circuited. The only further processing applied is the BeanPostProcessor.postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String) callback from the configured BeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回一个非空对象，则将短路 Bean 创建过程。唯一应用的进一步处理是配置的BeanPostProcessors中的BeanPostProcessor.postProcessAfterInitialization(Object, String)回调。

items.source: Specifying Spring's SimpleJndiBeanFactory leads to JNDI lookup behavior equivalent to standard Jakarta EE resource injection, even for name attributes and default names. This is the same behavior that the "alwaysUseJndiLookup" flag enables.
items.translation: 指定 Spring 的SimpleJndiBeanFactory会导致 JNDI 查找行为与标准的 Jakarta EE 资源注入等效，即使对于name属性和默认名称也是如此。这种行为与启用"alwaysUseJndiLookup"标志时的行为相同。

items.source: This post-processor also supports the EJB EJB annotation, analogous to Resource, with the capability to specify both a local bean name and a global JNDI name for fallback retrieval. The target beans can be plain POJOs as well as EJB Session Beans in this case.
items.translation: 此后置处理器同样支持 `EJB` 注解，类似于 `Resource`，具备指定本地 Bean 名称和全局 JNDI 名称以用于回退检索的能力。在此情况下，目标 Bean 可以是普通 POJO 以及 EJB Session Beans。

items.source: Default is "false": Resource names are used for Spring bean lookups in the containing BeanFactory; only mappedName attributes point directly into JNDI. Switch this flag to "true" for enforcing Jakarta EE style JNDI lookups in any case, even for name attributes and default names.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"：资源名称用于在包含的 BeanFactory 中查找 Spring bean；仅 `mappedName` 属性直接指向 JNDI。将此标志切换为 "true" 以强制在任何情况下（包括 `name` 属性和默认名称）执行 Jakarta EE 风格的 JNDI 查找。

items.source: The default is a SimpleJndiBeanFactory for JNDI lookup behavior equivalent to standard Jakarta EE resource injection.
items.translation: 默认值为 SimpleJndiBeanFactory，其 JNDI 查找行为与标准的 Jakarta EE 资源注入等效。

items.source: Post-processors may implement the extended SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor interface in order to predict the type of the bean object that they are going to return here.
items.translation: 后处理器可以实现扩展的SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor接口，以便预测它们在此处将要返回的 bean 对象的类型。

items.source: NOTE: A default CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor will be registered by the "context:annotation-config" and "context:component-scan" XML tags. Remove or turn off the default annotation configuration there if you intend to specify a custom CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor bean definition!
items.translation: 注意：“context:annotation-config”和“context:component-scan”XML 标签将注册一个默认的 CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor。如果您打算指定自定义的 CommonAnnotationBeanPostProcessor BeanDefinition，请移除或关闭那里的默认注解配置！

items.source:
Default is "true". Switch this flag to "false" in order to enforce a
by-name lookup in all cases, throwing an exception in case of no name match.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"。将此标志切换为 "false" 以在所有情况下强制按名称查找，若未找到匹配的名称则抛出异常。

items.source:
The default is the BeanFactory that this post-processor is defined in,
if any, looking up resource names as Spring bean names. Specify the resource
factory explicitly for programmatic usage of this post-processor.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果存在该后置处理器所在的 BeanFactory，则使用它，并将资源名称解析为 Spring bean 名称。若要程序化地使用此后置处理器，请显式指定资源工厂。

items.source: Process the given RegisteredBean instance ahead-of-time and return a contribution or null.
items.translation: 提前处理给定的RegisteredBean实例，并返回贡献对象或null。

items.translation: resourceType - 要忽略的资源类型

items.source: factory - the factory to autowire against
items.translation: factory - 要对其进行自动装配的工厂

items.source: NOTE: Annotation injection will be performed before XML injection; thus the latter configuration will override the former for properties wired through both approaches.
items.translation: 注意： 注解注入将在 XML 注入之前执行；因此，对于通过这两种方式连接的属性，后者的配置将覆盖前者。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: If the given instance isn't relevant to the processor, it should return a null contribution.
items.translation: 如果给定的实例与处理器不相关，则应返回一个 `null` 贡献。

items.source: The default implementation returns null.
items.translation: 默认实现返回null。

items.source: The default implementation returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given pvs as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的pvs。

items.source:
Processors are free to use any techniques they like to analyze the given
instance. Most typically use reflection to find fields or methods to use
in the contribution. Contributions typically generate source code or
resource files that can be used when the AOT optimized application runs.
items.translation: 处理器可以自由使用任何技术来分析给定的实例。大多数情况下，它们使用反射来查找用于贡献的字段或方法。贡献通常会生成源代码或资源文件，这些文件可在 AOT 优化后的应用程序运行时使用。

items.source: The default implementation is empty.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。

items.source:
This callback will be applied to bean definitions with their bean class,
as well as to factory-method definitions in which case the returned bean type
will be passed in here.
items.translation: 此回调将应用于具有其 Bean 类的 Bean 定义，以及工厂方法定义（在这种情况下，返回的 Bean 类型将在此处传入）。

items.source:
This is the ideal callback for performing custom field injection on the given bean
instance, right before Spring's autowiring kicks in.
items.translation: 这是在对给定 Bean 实例执行自定义字段注入的理想回调，正好在 Spring 的自动装配启动之前。

items.source: Specify the factory for objects to be injected into @Resource / @EJB annotated fields and setter methods, for mappedName attributes that point directly into JNDI.
items.translation: 指定要注入到带有 `@Resource` / `@EJB` 注解的字段和 setter 方法的工厂，针对直接指向 JNDI 的 mappedName 属性。

items.source: Specify the factory for objects to be injected into @Resource / @EJB annotated fields and setter methods, for name attributes and default names.
items.translation: 指定要注入到带有 `@Resource` / `@EJB` 注解的字段和 setter 方法的工厂，针对 `name` 属性和默认名称。

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：BeanFactoryAware

items.source: Set whether to always use JNDI lookups equivalent to standard Jakarta EE resource injection, even for name attributes and default names.
items.translation: 设置是否始终使用与标准 Jakarta EE 资源注入等效的 JNDI 查找，即使对于 `name` 属性和默认名称也是如此。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor before the target bean gets instantiated.
items.translation: 在目标 Bean 实例化之前应用此 BeanPostProcessor。

items.source:
Class representing generic injection information about an annotated field
or setter method, supporting @Resource and related annotations.
items.translation: 表示关于已注解字段或 setter 方法的通用注入信息的类，支持@Resource 及相关注解。

items.source:
Perform operations after the bean has been instantiated, via a constructor or factory method,
but before Spring property population (from explicit properties or autowiring) occurs.
items.translation: 在通过构造函数或工厂方法实例化 Bean 之后，但在 Spring 属性填充（来自显式属性或自动装配）发生之前执行操作。

items.source:
Post-process the given property values before the factory applies them
to the given bean.
items.translation: 在工厂将属性值应用到给定 Bean 之前，对给定的属性值进行后处理。

items.source:
A notification that the bean definition for the specified name has been reset,
and that this post-processor should clear any metadata for the affected bean.
items.translation: 指定名称的 Bean 定义已被重置的通知，且此后置处理器应清除受影响 Bean 的任何元数据。

items.source: Callback that supplies the owning factory to a bean instance.
items.translation: 向 Bean 实例提供其所属工厂的回调。

items.source:
Set whether to allow a fallback to a type match if no explicit name has been
specified.
items.translation: 设置是否允许在未指定显式名称时回退到类型匹配。

items.source: true if properties should be set on the bean; false if property population should be skipped. Normal implementations should return true. Returning false will also prevent any subsequent InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor instances being invoked on this bean instance.
items.translation: 如果应在 Bean 上设置属性，则返回true；如果应跳过属性填充，则返回false。正常实现应返回true。返回false还将阻止在此 Bean 实例上调用任何后续的 InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor 实例。

items.source: beanFactory - owning BeanFactory (never null). The bean can immediately call methods on the factory.
items.translation: beanFactory - 拥有该 Bean 的 BeanFactory（永远不会为 null）。 该 Bean 可以立即调用工厂上的方法。

items.source: pvs - the property values that the factory is about to apply (never null)
items.translation: pvs - 工厂即将应用的属性值（永远不为 null）

items.source: beanDefinition - the merged bean definition for the bean
items.translation: beanDefinition - 该 Bean 的合并后的 Bean 定义

items.source: beanType - the actual type of the managed bean instance
items.translation: beanType - 托管 Bean 实例的实际类型

items.source: registeredBean - the registered bean to process
items.translation: registeredBean - 要处理的已注册 Bean

items.source: beanClass - the class of the bean to be instantiated
items.translation: beanClass - 要实例化的 Bean 的类

items.source: the bean object to expose instead of a default instance of the target bean, or null to proceed with default instantiation
items.translation: 要暴露的 Bean 对象，而不是目标 Bean 的默认实例，或 `null` 以使用默认实例化。

items.source: bean - the bean instance created, with properties not having been set yet
items.translation: bean - 已创建但属性尚未设置的 Bean 实例

items.source: bean - the bean instance created, but whose properties have not yet been set
items.translation: bean - 已创建但属性尚未设置的 bean 实例

items.source: the actual property values to apply to the given bean (can be the passed-in PropertyValues instance), or null to skip property population
items.translation: 要应用于给定 Bean 的实际属性值（可以是传入的 `PropertyValues` 实例），或 `null` 以跳过属性填充。

items.source: bean - the target instance to process
items.translation: bean - 要处理的目标实例
